identity.description: An attacker executes an AppleScript through the command line to capture clipboard data and screen shots, which is flagged by Cortex analytics as suspicious behavior. The attack involves scripting and automation techniques to exfiltrate sensitive data.

biocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript Execution via CLI
biocs.description: Detection of AppleScript execution initiated from command-line interface, which is unusual for typical user behavior.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash' and action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'osascript'

abiocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript Designed to Capture Screen or Clipboard Data
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation detected when AppleScript is executed from command line to capture clipboard or screen data.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash' and action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'clipboard' or action_process_command_line contains 'screenshot'
